name: html-storybook
description: HTML storybook - shows rendered HTML output for React stories

scripts.build: node ../_shared/storybook-config/copy-config.ts --storybook html-storybook && node ../_shared/overview/generate-overviews.ts --storybook html-storybook && storybook build --output-dir ../../build-storybooks/html-storybook
scripts.storybook: node ../_shared/storybook-config/copy-config.ts --storybook html-storybook && node ../_shared/overview/generate-overviews.ts --storybook html-storybook && storybook dev -p 6008
